name: GPU-based Voxelization via Compute Shader
definition: A technique to convert 3D triangle meshes into a voxel grid representation using a GPU compute shader. The input is a set of triangles; the output is a 3D boolean grid indicating which voxels are occupied.
summary: GPU-based Voxelization via Compute Shader converts 3D triangle meshes into voxel grids by offloading rasterization to parallel GPU shaders, differing from CPU methods.
